requirements.detail: Install the k8s-nim-operator chart from https://helm.ngc.nvidia.com/nvidia at >=3.1.0 and wait for nimservices.apps.nvidia.com before applying this sample. The k8s-nim-operator chart is not yet a Catalog entry on this branch, so this requirement names the chart and does not link a record.
Create the image pull Secret ngc-secret (NIMService spec.image.pullSecrets) in the sample's namespace before apply. The sample carries the name only, and no credential is held here.
Create the API key Secret ngc-api-secret (NIMService spec.authSecret) in the sample's namespace before apply. The sample carries the name only, and no key or token is held here.
The NIMService mounts the node path /mnt/models/llama-3.2-1b-instruct, so every node that can run it must hold that path. Nothing here checked that a destination can provide it.
The NIMService requests 1 GPU per pod as nvidia.com/gpu, with 1 replica. A destination needs that many allocatable GPUs of a kind the image supports, and nothing here checked one.
Every object in the sample is in the nim-service namespace. The sample ships no Namespace object, so the namespace must exist before apply.
